what: Cards: on each card (cover), a pill with that work’s short tagline spawns every .5s at a spot within ±10% of the card center, drifts in a random direction at 0.3~1.5px/frame and bounces off the card walls — like a screensaver logo. If the same text is already floating it is skipped, and when more than 10 exist the oldest is removed first. When the card leaves the screen or the window loses focus, no new ones are spawned and they are cleared. Each card starts staggered by 0.1~2s

options.[data-fx-part=tag]: Footer source (children, several) — hidden, only the text is read and spawned in shuffled order
options.max: Max number floating per card, default 10
options.area: Range where cards spawn from the center (ratio of half width and height), default .1
options.delay-min: Minimum wait before the first spawn (ms), default 100
options.delay-max: Max wait before first spawn (ms), default 2000
options.--fx-tag-bg: Pill background (css), default var(--kf-bg) — original is the card background color
options.--fx-tag-ink: Pill text (css), default card text color
options.--fx-tag-glow: Glow color for the 4px blur around the pill (css), default text color

use: Monthly seriesUpdated on the 4th of each month…
note: The pill has pointer-events: none so it doesn’t block card presses or phone scrolling — the original also runs as is on touch devices. Under reduced motion only the first three sit in fixed spots inside the card. It adds the same px every frame as the original does, so it looks twice as fast on 120Hz screens

from.where: index.html .sw-card[data-fx~=bounce-tag-spawn] — original .js-text-bounce-container (data-max 10 · data-interval 500, speed .3~1.5, first spawn Qe(100,2000)ms, cleared when off-screen via IntersectionObserver, paused when the window blurs)
